Files that fail ONLY because vinext does not implement the Next.js 16.3 client-router architecture. Separate from test/compat-vinext-ledger.json, whose bounds (15 files, 30-day expiry) are unchanged. Bounds, enforced by scripts/compat-vinext-structural-gaps.mjs: ONE shared gap record; reviewBy at most 92 days after recorded (past it the run reds); at most 41 files, frozen at the count first quarantined and only ever lowered (49 originally, lowered after the vinext 1.1.0 measurement) (adding a file needs a new ADR-0007 amendment); every file a real manifest corpus member; vinext lane only. Files are RECLASSIFIED after the run at case granularity, never removed from the corpus: a new failing case in a ledgered file stays a real failure, and a file that passes reds as stale. `cases` is the intersection of the cases that failed in both evidence runs. vinext stays Beta; this ledger does not make the lane a credential.
